title: t-Test Translator
summary: Reproduce SPSS's Group Statistics and Independent Samples Test tables, both rows and Levene's test, from an SPSS file.
hints: `teach$method <- as_factor(teach$method)` turns the codes 1 and 2 into Lecture and Active learning.
Levene's row: `leveneTest(score ~ method, data = teach, center = mean)`. The two t rows: `t.test(score ~ method, data = teach, var.equal = TRUE)` and the same without `var.equal`.
SPSS's one-sided p is half the two-sided p (when the difference is in the predicted direction): `student$p.value / 2`.
